title: Buyable Raids
description: adds a chat command to purchase bad omen 1 or 2 with diamonds
body:
A lightweight Paper plugin that lets players spend diamonds to summon raids with /raid 1 or /raid 2.

---
Currently, you have to be inside of a village for the raid to actually trigger.

---
For the future, I plan to make it so that a villager spawns nearby for the raid to actually trigger anywhere, and despawns whenever the raid ends, so players cannot gain a free villager.

---
